coverage_assessment: Open-web discovery captured 18 search actions/batches and 485 ordered result headers. French and English queries and Nigerien, regional, international, official, observer, and rights-report sources were represented; Hausa/Zarma, local radio, weekly/date/sector searching, LexisNexis, and full-text access remain incomplete. 4 source cards retain opened status: 3 prior-unit consultations and 1 current-unit body read (S005). The post-runoff candidate remains pending because turnout threshold, gathering-level demand/ownership, local unit boundaries, physical end, and complete event-linked state response are not established. Zero candidates were excluded or assigned absence.
